appearance.style_source_summary: World style is taken from the shared unit style contract: cold industrial post-collapse realism for humans and props with a separated stylisation layer for bone pattern, twin flame, grey fog and altered bodies. No external appearance reference image was supplied for this unit, so no reference route is registered and every entity is styled from the world style alone.

global_style_bible.world_and_era: post-collapse industrial city ruins; a walled mechanical factory compound with one gate, a brick street in front of it and an outskirts bone well being sunk outside the city; ration queues, name rosters and posted notices govern daily life; survivors and ceramic-pale altered ones share the same cold daylight and fog; no readable signage and no modern branding
global_style_bible.visual_language: grounded industrial realism for humans and props with a separated stylisation layer for the bone pattern, the ash motes, the twin flame, the white smoke and the projected interface text; stylised elements never spill across into the human layer and every body surface stays intact
global_style_bible.palette: grey fog cyan-grey #4A5A5C as the global base, ink shadow #171B1D with detail kept in the darks, plaster white #C6C2B8 for ceramic shells, pure-fire white #F5F7F8 and black #0B0B0C for the twin colour bone pattern and the twin flame, weld and fire orange #E07B39 as the only warm accent, dark red #7A2027 reserved for the fighter's outfit and never for any liquid
global_style_bible.material_language: real skin with pores and slight oil sheen, matte technical fabric with wear and dust, oxidised steel with dull reflections, cold ceramic shells on altered bodies; every surface stays intact and no red liquid appears anywhere in the frame
global_style_bible.environment_design: a brick street cut by wheel ruts in front of a single gate with two steel posts, a gate wall with one open cross street at the far end, a registration desk and a triage table inside the gate, one steel table in the inner factory room with a name board on its north wall, and one wooden derrick over a square well mouth on the outskirts
global_style_bible.prop_design: functional utilitarian tooling with real weight and thickness: gate posts, threshold stone, a flagpole and its cloth, steel crates and tables, rosters and notices, a data tablet, a terminal, a sealed letter, a winch and its rope, a name board and vapour cores; all carry visible use marks
global_style_bible.lighting_and_atmosphere: one cold overhead key over the steel table with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the emergency lamps on the gate posts, the residual fire heads, the twin flame and the derrick lamp as the only moving light sources, and the grey fog pressing down over the street with the unlit crossing kept dark
